title: Home flat: the article card deleted on every page; the home and Projects hero panels and feature cards become type on the ground with one hairline rule; only the captioned media card stays on /
first: Map: docs/masthead-campaign.md, section 'Cards: inventory and cuts (map revision 3)'. Ruling in force: site-masthead:ruling:operator-no-cards-except-floats, operator's words: "I would indeed prefer to get rid of cards, unless they're containing something that floats, like a captioned image". A card is any box with its own fill, border, radius or shadow around content. Line numbers below are read from 410485e; re-read by selector before editing.

What the operator saw on a phone on /: the intro text in .gamecult-hero-panel (card, custom.scss 2084-2098 and 2100-2113) nested inside the article card (.page > #quartz-body .center > article, 1057-1067). Both go. The figure.gamecult-media-card beside the hero (index.md 72-75: an img and a caption) is the operator's own example of a card that stays.

The one replacement mechanism, site-wide: whitespace, typographic hierarchy, and the hairline rule, 1px solid var(--gamecult-rule), on the top edge of a section or row, with the existing mono/uppercase/tracked label (.gamecult-kicker, .gamecult-repo-fact-label) naming it. The site already uses this hairline in three places with two literal colours: .gamecult-studio-page .gamecult-feature-card 2353 and .swarm-domain-card 2932 (rgba(148,163,184,.22)), .gamecult-overview-group 1313 (rgba(89,183,255,.08)). This cut names the token and uses the grey value; later cuts switch the sky literal to it.

Pages after this cut: every page's article sits on the ground (body wash, a scoped variant's ground, or the Thing hero) with no box; / and /Projects show title, tagline, kicker, hero copy, action pills (untouched, pending) and the evidence note as a left-ruled aside; the two feature cards on / are ruled sections. The deleted card's padding (1.45rem 1.7rem) is not replaced: content runs to the column's edge, which is the full-width-content direction.

Pills (.gamecult-action, .gamecult-repo-link) are a separate pending item under self-masthead-pills-first; not touched here. The masthead is not touched. Deploy: push to main -> Deploy Quartz -> GitHub Pages; CI is the verifier; measure with the browser pane's viewport emulation.

The hero panel's three padding rules: 2111-2113 (.gamecult-hero-panel), 2293-2295 (.gamecult-studio-page .gamecult-hero-panel), 2486-2488 (@media mobile .gamecult-hero-panel). A section with no box has no inset.

docs/brand-design-language.md: a new section '## Surfaces' between '## Masthead' (ends 95) and '## Ritual Paper' (97): the site has no cards; a content box never carries its own fill, border, radius or shadow unless it holds something that floats in the flow (a captioned image or figure; an embed's own edge; a popover). Grouping is whitespace, type hierarchy and the hairline rule --gamecult-rule on the top edge of a section or row, named by the mono uppercase tracked label. Six to ten lines, by selector and token, no line numbers. In '## Applying this outside the site' (137-144) the 'Panels #16212c' phrase becomes 'rules rgba(148,163,184,.22), no panels'. The 'Written' line (15) already says revised 2026-10-02.
GameCult/Docs/Site-Architecture.md 32-33: 'hero panels' becomes 'hero sections' and the sentence no longer promises panels; one-line edit.
